b:
On the beach sand
her footprints stand
unbroken

Waves,
do not build a dam over them;
I am begging
to worship
the sand her feet touched

She who was right beside me
moves away
in tears

Wind,
you too go as my messenger
and dry
her tears;
I cannot bear to see them

Sky,
are you also
on her side?
Why do you make the sun
set so soon?

The moment she leaned on my shoulder
our friendship was lost too;
why call me a friend
and keep me far away?

Did she
never feel
the fireflies hidden in her eyes
flash into me
like lightning?

She is acting.
Would she have stayed with me for hours
if it were not in her heart?

So that the words
would be lost in the moving of mouths,
lips pressed together

After hearts joined
in one great unblinking instant,
was what we did a great mistake?

"No,"
as if to say,
a hand joined mine
